lesson: Always modify existing files in-place using appropriate libraries (e.g., python-docx) instead of creating new files unless explicitly instructed.
CRITICAL: Identify and CLOSE the target file in the GUI before executing modification scripts to prevent permission errors.
Perform COMPLETE OVERWRITES of content blocks/paragraphs rather than appending, to ensure the final state is deterministic.
Strictly preserve existing headers, titles, styles, and structural elements unless the task specifically requests changing them.
Ensure fonts, colors, and formatting are maintained during script-based modifications.

LibreOffice Writer is designed for single-user editing. It does not have real-time multi-user collaborative editing features like Google Docs. Document sharing requires manual file exchange or server-based document management.
